summary: Controls Google's prompt-rewriting layer before video generation. Turning it off preserves literal wording; leaving it on can expand short prompts, but may also alter carefully authored camera or timing instructions.
combines: The current @google/genai converter sends parameters.enhancePrompt on both Gemini Developer API and Vertex paths.
Lixpi does not send this field because its prompts are already assembled by the reasoning pipeline; adopting it would create a second rewrite step whose effect must be evaluated first.
